title: kc-ship-close-receipt v2
description: The cloud-wrapper redesign's close receipt (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-10-ship-flow-cloud-wrapper-design.md, section 'closed'). Written by close.py once every task in the sprint shows a merged PR and a pushed-or-failed debrief, or is recorded captain_stopped. Slimmed relative to v1: no plan/approval receipt shas, no dev_debrief/ship_debrief blocks -- those belonged to the plan-flow batch-dir world this design replaces; debriefs are written by each worker via `spacedock debrief`, never by ship on a worker's behalf.

pr.description: the task entity's own pr: frontmatter value, e.g. pr-merge:<N>

debrief.description: a _debriefs/... path once pushed, or a 'failure: ...' string when pending, rejected twice, or captain_stopped
